This is a template to enter the more cumbersome characters by number.

{{CreatureInfo v0.34|name=Example ray|symbol={{char|16}}|color=5:0:1
|biome=
* any
}}
===Usage===
<nowiki>{{char|decimal number}}</nowiki>

===Examples===
{|
|<nowiki>{{char|2}}</nowiki>
|{{char|2}}
|-
|<nowiki>{{char|16}}</nowiki>
|{{char|16}}
|-
|<nowiki>{{char|211}}</nowiki>
|{{char|211}}
|-
|<nowiki>{{char|146}}</nowiki>
|{{char|146}}
|-
|<nowiki>{{char|234}}</nowiki>
|{{char|234}}
|}
